verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS planning platform like Pigment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents adjacent privacy and security controls (data residency region choice, an audit trail API, fine-grained access rights, admin approval of AI assistants), but none of them is a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Those adjacent controls earn no credit for this story.
